last_episode_to_air.name: Episode 32
last_episode_to_air.overview:
They drown into a lake. GOU rescues SHEUNG. YUNG arrives. She wants to kill the Enchanter. She asks the twin condors for help. The Enchanter hurts the male condor. The male condor falls down from the cliff. The female condor rush to the bottom of the valley to rescue the male condor. It finds SHEUNG and brings her back to the cliff edge. YUNG asks SHEUNG to watch the Enchanter. The others then climb down to save GOU. However, they cannot find GOU at the bottom of the lake. They then go back to the cliff top. However, they find that even SHEUNG and the Enchanter have disappeared.

Now it comes to the climax of this story. Where has GOU gone? Will he meet LUNG again? Will SHEUNG be all right? Could CHING defeat the Mongolian? Please watch the final for the details.

name: The Condor Heroes 95
overview: The Condor Heroes 95 is a Hong Kong television series adapted from Louis Cha's novel The Return of the Condor Heroes. It was first broadcast on TVB Jade in Hong Kong in 1995. Many of the cast from The Legend of the Condor Heroes reprised their roles in this series, such as Lau Dan and Wayne Lai. In addition, Jason Pai reprised his breakthrough role as Kwok Ching, whom he previously portrayed in The Legend of the Condor Heroes and The Return of the Condor Heroes.
